## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.3.0

### Highlights
- 🎮 **Chat that looks like the game**: same font (Bahnschrift SemiBold SemiCondensed), the partial black outline, one colour per line and the `[dd/mm/yyyy - HH:MM:SS]` timestamp. Squadmates are lime green, other chat is blue, server messages are yellow.
- 🔗 **Players by SteamID**: the app remembers every player's permanent SteamID. Link a base to a player by nickname, SteamID or Steam profile link, and the name updates automatically when they rename. Hover a base on the map to click through to their Steam profile.
- 🟢 **Squadmates setting**: list your squadmates in **Settings → Chat → Players** to show them in green.

### Added
- Player registry (`players.json`) built from the `Message from user:` lines of `SCUM.log`; tracks nickname changes.
- Base players accept nicknames, SteamID64 or `steamcommunity.com/profiles/…` links; hover card and right-click menu open Steam profiles.
- Squadmates list (included in settings profiles).

### Changed
- Overlay chat styling matches the in-game chat (font, outline, colours, timestamp format). Default size is 22 px.
- A colour given in a message (`<color=#rrggbb>`, `[color=#rrggbb]`, `<font color="#rrggbb">`) is used as is.

### Fixed
- Chat timestamps now use local time like the game (the log stores UTC).

### Notes
- `SCUM.log` does not say which channel (squad, local, global) a message came from, so squadmates are recognised by the nickname list. Local chat cannot be told apart from global.
- Your saved font size is kept; to get the new look set **Settings → Appearance → Font size** to 22 and turn off *Bold*.
- `players.json` is user data: it is never touched by updates.

### First launch
Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time. This is normal for free unsigned apps and is **not** a virus warning: click **More info → Run anyway** once. Details in the [README](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map#-windows-says-protected-your-pc--is-this-a-virus).

### Files
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe`: standard build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`: portable build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_v2.3.0.zip`: exe + instructions

`config.json`, `points.json`, `profiles.json` and `players.json` are not shipped: the app creates them next to the exe on first launch.
